name: Journey Diary Import
changes: The Pro notice of Journey Diary Import now says that one payment turns on Pro in every NoteMods plugin.
tip: Set the note folder to your daily note folder and turn on Merge by date to append entries.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Journey Diary Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your diary into Obsidian with it.
